sEn: This paper introduces the backpropagation algorithm for training multi-layer neural networks with hidden units, enabling them to learn internal representations.
sZh: 本文介绍了用于训练具有隐藏单元的多层神经网络的反向传播算法，使其能够学习内部表征。

contrib.en: Introduced the generalized delta rule (backpropagation) for learning internal representations in multilayer networks.
contrib.zh: 提出了广义delta规则（反向传播），用于在多层网络中学习内部表示。

contrib.en: Demonstrated that gradient descent on semilinear activation functions effectively trains networks, with rare local minima.
contrib.zh: 证明了对半线性激活函数进行梯度下降可有效训练网络，局部最小值罕见。

contrib.en: Showed networks discover elegant internal representations for XOR, parity, encoder, symmetry, and addition problems.

contrib.en: Proposed momentum term and random initial weights to avoid symmetry and accelerate convergence.
contrib.zh: 提出了动量项和随机初始权重，以避免对称性问题并加速收敛。

limits.en: Cannot guarantee global optimum; local minima occur in some tasks like binary addition.

limits.en: Requires nonlinear differentiable activation functions; linear threshold units not applicable.
limits.zh: 需要非线性可微的激活函数，线性阈值单元不适用。

limits.en: Learning speed sensitive to hyperparameters like learning rate and momentum; poor choices cause oscillation or slow convergence.
limits.zh: 学习速度对学习率和动量等超参数敏感，选择不当会导致振荡或收敛缓慢。

limits.en: Some problems need extra hidden units to avoid local minima, increasing model complexity.
limits.zh: 某些问题需要额外隐藏单元以避免局部最小值，增加了模型复杂度。

limits.en: Learned internal representations are often distributed and hard to interpret.
limits.zh: 学习到的内部表示通常是分布式的，难以解释。

paras.en: We have run this problem i n this way a number of ti mes. As a result, we have found a n umber of sol utions. Perhaps the simplest way to understand the system is by looking at the form of the recepti ve field for the h idden units. Figure 1 5 shows several of the recepti ve fields we have seen. 7 Figure 1 5 A shows the most local represen tation developed . This on-center-o ff-surround detector turns out to be an excellent T detector. Since, as i l l ust rated, a T can extend into the on center and achieve a net input of + 1 , this detector wi ll be tu rned on for a T at any orientation. On the other hand, any C extending into the center m ust cover at least two inhi bitory cells. Wi th this detector the bias can be set so that only one of the whole field of inhibi tory units wi l l come on whenever a T is presented and none of the hidden units wi l l be turned on by any C. This is a kind of protrusion detector which d ifferenti ates between a T and C by detecti ng the protrusion of the T.

Thus, the problem of speci fying the correct learning rule for recurrent networks i s simply one of determi n i ng the appropriate value of 8 for each time. In a feedforward network we determine 8 by multi plying the deri vative of the acti vation funct i on by the sum of the 8 's for those u n i ts it feeds into weighted by the connecti on st rengths. The same process works for the recurrent network - except in this case, the value of 8 associated with a particular unit changes i n time as a unit passes error back, someti mes to i tsel f. After each iteration, as error is being passed back th rough the network, the change i n weight for that i teration must be added to the weight changes specified by the preced ing iterations and the sum stored. Th is process of passing error through the network should continue for a n umber of i terations equal to the number of i terati ons through which the activation was originally passed . At this point, the appropriate changes to all of the weights can be made. In general , the procedu re for a recu rrent network is that an input (generally a sequence) i s presented to the system while it runs for some number of iterations. At certain speci fied ti mes during the operation of the system, the output of certain units are compared to the target for that unit at th at time and error signals are generated. Each such error signal is then passed back through the network for a number of i tera tions equal to the n umber of i terations used in the forward pass. Weight changes are computed at each i terati on and a sum of all the weight changes dictated for a particular weight is saved . Fi nally, after all such error signals have been propagated through the system , the weights are changed . The major problem wi th this procedure is the memory requi red. Not only does the system have to hold i ts summed weight changes whi l e the error is being propagated , but each unit must somehow record the sequence of acti vat i on val ues through which it was dri ven during the original processing. This follows from the fact that during each iteration wh ile the error is passed back through the system, the cu rrent 8 is relevant to a poi nt earl ier in t i me and the requ i red weight changes depend on the activation levels of the units at that time. paras.zh: 学习成为移位寄存器。或许我们研究过的最简单的循环问题类别是输入和输出单元相同且没有隐藏单元的情况。我们简单地呈现一个模式，让系统处理一段时间。然后将系统的状态与某个目标状态进行比较。如果在指定时间未达到目标状态，则向系统注入误差并修改其权重。然后，给它一个新的输入模式并重新启动。在这些情况下，对系统中的连接没有约束。任何单元都可以连接到任何其他单元。我们研究过的最简单的此类问题称为移位寄存器问题。在这个问题中，单元被概念化为一个循环移位寄存器。首先在单元上建立任意位模式。然后让它们处理两个时间步。两个时间步后的目标状态是原始模式左移两位。这里有趣的问题涉及到起始状态呈现与目标状态呈现之间的时间内单元的状态。解决问题的一种方法是让系统成为一个移位寄存器，并在每个时间段内将模式向左精确移动一位。如果系统这样做了，那么两个时间单元后它肯定会被左移两位。我们用三或五个单元组成的组尝试了这个问题，如果我们约束所有单元的偏置为负（因此单元在未激活时关闭），系统总能学会成为这种移位寄存器。因此，尽管原则上任何单元都可以连接到任何其他单元，但系统实际上学会了将所有权重设置为零，除了将一个单元连接到其左侧邻居的权重。由于目标状态是在假设循环寄存器的情况下确定的，最左边的单元与最右边的单元之间形成了强连接。系统学习得相当快。当η=0.25时，在三或五单元系统中，它在不到200次遍历所有可能模式的情况下就完美学会了。到目前为止描述的任务非常简单，但它们确实说明了该算法如何处理无限制网络。我们还尝试了一些更困难的循环网络问题。

paras.en: Learning to be a shift register. Perhaps the si mplest class of recurrent problems we have studied i s one i n which the i n put and out put units are one and the same and there a re no hidden units. We sim ply present a pattern and let the system process i t for a period of t i me . The state of t h e system is t h e n compared to some target state . If i t hasn ' t reached the target state a t t h e designated ti me, error is i njected into the system and it modifies its weights. Then it is shown a new input pattern and restarted. In these cases , there is no constrai nt on the connections i n the system . Any unit can connect to any other unit. The simplest such problem we have studied is what we call the shift register problem. In this problem, the units are concept ualized as a cir cular shift register. An arbi trary bit pattern is fi rst established on the units. They are then allowed to process for two time-steps. The target state , after those two ti me-steps, is the original pattern shifted two spaces to the l eft . The i nteresting question here concerns the state of the units between the presentati on of the start state and the time at which the target state is presented. One sol ution to the problem is for the system to become a shift regi ster and shift the pattern exactly one unit to the left during each t i me period . If the system did this then it would surely be shifted two places to the left after two time units. We have t ried this problem with groups of th ree or fi ve units and , if we constrai n the biases on al l of the units to be negative (so the units are off unless turned on) , the system always learns to be a shift register of this sort . IO Thus, even though in princi ple any unit can connect to any other unit, the system actual ly learns to set all weights to zero except the ones connecting a uni t to i ts l eft neighbor. Si nce the target states were determined on the assumption of a circular register, the left-most unit developed a strong connection to the right-most unit. The system learns this relati vely quickly. With T/ = 0 . 2 5 it learns perfectly in fewer than 200 sweeps through the set of possible patterns with ei ther three or five- unit systems. The tasks we have descri bed so far are excepti onal ly simple, but they do i l l ustrate how the algorithm works with unrestricted networks. We have attempted a few more difficult problems with recurrent networks.

paras.zh: 在Minsky和Papert（1969）对感知器的悲观讨论中，他们最终在书的末尾讨论了多层机器。他们指出：感知器尽管（甚至是因为！）其严重的局限性，已经证明值得研究。它具有许多吸引人的特点：其线性；其有趣的学习定理；其作为并行计算的清晰范式简单性。没有理由认为这些优点中的任何一个能延续到多层版本，尽管如此，我们认为阐明（或否定）我们的直觉判断（即扩展是贫瘠的）是一个重要的研究问题。也许会发现一些强大的收敛定理，或者会找到某种深刻的原因，说明为什么多层机器未能产生有趣的“学习定理”。（第231-232页）虽然我们的学习结果不能保证我们能找到所有可解问题的解，但我们的分析和结果表明，实际上，误差传播方案几乎在每种情况下都能找到解。简而言之，我们相信我们已经回答了Minsky和Papert的挑战，并找到了一个足够强大的学习结果，证明他们对多层机器学习的悲观是错误的。描述我们程序的一种方式是将它视为一台并行计算机，在向它展示了指定某个函数的适当输入/输出示例后，它能自我编程以计算该函数。并行计算机是出了名的难以编程。这里我们有一种机制，我们实际上不需要知道如何编写程序就能让系统完成它。Parker（1985）强调了这一点。362 基本机制
